en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from one of our companions,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is a limit of the generosity?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is what comes out from the owner of the right which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Obligated upon you, so you place it in its (appropriate) place’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from certain individuals of our people who has said the following: “
I asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘What is the limit of generosity?’ The Imam replied, ‘It is to pay what Allah has made obligatory on you to pay to properly deserving recipients.’”
